topics.description: The Minnesota Medicaid fraud scheme involves a large-scale investigation into fraudulent activities within the state's Medicaid program. Recent developments include charges against 15 individuals for their involvement in a $90 million fraud scheme. This topic is trending due to the significant financial impact and the number of people involved.

California Governor Gavin Newsom has announced that he and his wife are under investigation by the Department of Justice. This investigation is allegedly politically motivated and centers around accusations of misconduct. The topic is trending due to the political implications and the involvement of high-profile figures.
